definitions.explanation: A humble expression for receiving something from someone of higher status. Shows respect by lowering oneself.

examples.japanese: お⟦{名刺|めいし}→名刺：01090_meishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{頂戴|ちょうだい}⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: May I have your business card?

examples.japanese: ありがたく{頂戴|ちょうだい}⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
⟦{少々|しょうしょう}→少々：03232_shoushou⟧お⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{頂戴|ちょうだい}したい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧。
examples.english: I would like to have a little of your time.

notes:
{頂戴|ちょうだい}する is a humble verb (⟦{謙譲語|けんじょうご}→謙譲語：15869_kenjougo⟧) for receiving.

KEIGO LEVEL:
This is a very formal humble expression, commonly used in business settings.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {頂戴|ちょうだい}⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧: I will receive (very humble)
- お⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{頂戴|ちょうだい}する: to take someone's time
- ご⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{頂戴|ちょうだい}する: to receive opinions

INFORMAL USAGE:
{頂戴|ちょうだい} alone (without ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧) is used casually, especially by children or women, meaning "give me please."
